# Generated by EyerissMapper
# Batch = 64, In Feature = 72, Out Feature = 32

#set constant
.set IF, 72
.set OF, 32
.set B, 64
#mapping parameter
.set M, 64
.set K, 6
.set N, 8
.set N_times_16, 128	 # 8 * 4 * 4
.set outf_offset, 32	 # 8 * 4
.set inf_offset, 72	 # 6 * 3 * 4
.set b_offset, 64	 # M
.set k_offset, 6	 # tk
.set n_offset, 8	 # tn
.set m_offset, 1	 # mode

.set PE_ARRAY_WEIGHT_SIZE, 2304	# 48 * 12 * 4
.set PE_ARRAY_IPSUM_SIZE, 128	# 8 * 1 * 4 * 4
.set PE_ARRAY_IFMAP_SIZE, 72	# 6 * 3 * 4
.set GLB_IFMAP_SIZE, 4608	# M * K * 12
.set GLB_WEIGHT_SIZE, 2304	# K * 3 * N * 4 * 4
.set GLB_OPSUM_SIZE, 8192	# B * N * 16
.set DRAM_IFMAP_SIZE, 4608
.set DRAM_WEIGHT_SIZE, 2304
.set DRAM_OPSUM_SIZE, 8192

SET_ID
CFG_SET DRAM_IFMAP_BASE,     0
CFG_SET DRAM_WEIGHT_BASE,    1
CFG_SET DRAM_OFMAP_BASE,     2
CFG_SET GLB_IFMAP_BASE,      3
CFG_SET GLB_WEIGHT_BASE,     4
CFG_SET GLB_OPSUM_BASE,      5
CFG_SET OF_SIZE, 6
CFG_SET IF_SIZE, 7
CFG_SET B_SIZE,  8
CFG_SET K_SIZE,  9
CFG_SET N_SIZE,  10
CFG_SET M_SIZE,  11
CFG_SET MODE,    12
CFG_SET DATA_FLOW, 13

LOADI outf,  0
LOADI inf,   0
LOADI b,     0
LOADI k,     0
LOADI n,     0
LOADI m,     0
LOADI REG[7], 6
LOADI REG[8], 0
LOADI REG[9], 0
LOADI REG[10], 0
LOADI REG[11], 0
LOADI REG[12], 0
LOADI REG[13], 0
LOADI REG[14], 0
LOADI REG[15], 0

# Output feature tiles
loop_outf:
    #load PSUM to GLB
    MULI REG[14], outf, 4 #REG[14] = outf * 4
    DMA_LOAD_PSUM DRAM_OFMAP_BASE, REG[14], GLB_OPSUM_SIZE
    WAIT DMA
    NOP
    loop_inf:
        #load WEIGHT to GLB
        #compute index
        MULI REG[8], outf, IF
        ADD REG[8], REG[8], inf #REG[8] = (inf + outf * in_features);
        DMA_LOAD_WEIGHT DRAM_WEIGHT_BASE, REG[8], GLB_WEIGHT_SIZE
        WAIT DMA
        NOP
        loop_b:
            #load IFMAP to GLB
            #compute index
            MULI REG[9], b, IF
            ADD REG[9], REG[9], inf #REG[9] = (b * in_feature + inf);
            DMA_LOAD_IFMAP DRAM_IFMAP_BASE, REG[9], GLB_IFMAP_SIZE
            WAIT DMA
            NOP
            loop_k:
                loop_n:
                    #start pe array
                    COMPUTE
                    #compute index
                    MULI REG[10], n, K
                    MULI REG[10], REG[10], 4
                    ADD REG[10], REG[10], k 
                    MULI REG[10],REG[10], 12 #REG[10] = k * 3 * 4 + n * 4 * map.K * 3 * 4
                    #load weight to pe array
                    CPT_TAGXY WEIGHT
                    G2P GLB_WEIGHT_BASE, REG[10], PE_ARRAY_WEIGHT_SIZE
                    WAIT GLB
                    NOP
                    loop_m:
                        #compute index
                        MULI REG[11], b, N_times_16 #REG[11] = b * map.N * PE::WEIGHT_H * 4
                        MULI REG[12], m, N_times_16 #REG[12] = m * map.N * PE::WEIGHT_H * 4
                        MULI REG[15], n, 16         #REG[15] = n * 4 * 4
                        ADD REG[11], REG[11], REG[12]
                        ADD REG[11], REG[11], REG[15] #REG[11] = (b * map.N * PE::WEIGHT_H * 4) 
                                                      #          + n * 4 + m * map.N * PE::WEIGHT_H * 4
                        #------loop------#
                        #load ipsum to pe array
                        CPT_TAGXY IPSUM
                        G2P GLB_OPSUM_BASE, REG[11], PE_ARRAY_IPSUM_SIZE
                        WAIT GLB
                        NOP

                        #compute index
                        MULI REG[13], m, K
                        ADD REG[13], REG[13], k 
                        MULI REG[13], REG[13], 12 #REG[13] = k * 3 * 4 + m * map.K * PE::IFMAP_SIZE * 4
                        #------loop------#
                        #load ifmap to pe array
                        CPT_TAGXY IFMAP
                        G2P GLB_IFMAP_BASE, REG[13], PE_ARRAY_IFMAP_SIZE
                        WAIT GLB
                        NOP
                        #------loop finish------#

                        WAIT PE_ARRAY
                        NOP

                        #------loop------#
                        #write to GLB
                        CPT_TAGXY OPSUM
                        P2G_OPSUM GLB_OPSUM_BASE, REG[11], PE_ARRAY_IPSUM_SIZE
                        WAIT GLB
                        NOP
                        NOP
                        #------loop finish------#
                        LOOP M_SIZE, m, loop_m, m_offset
                        NOP
                    LOOP N_SIZE, n, loop_n, n_offset
                    NOP
                LOOP K_SIZE, k, loop_k, k_offset
                NOP
            LOOP B_SIZE, b, loop_b, b_offset
            NOP
        LOOP IF_SIZE, inf, loop_inf, inf_offset
        NOP
    #write opsum to DRAM
    CPT_TAGXY OPSUM
    DMA_STORE_OFMAP DRAM_OFMAP_BASE, REG[14], GLB_OPSUM_SIZE
    WAIT DMA
    NOP
    NOP
    LOOP OF_SIZE, outf, loop_outf, outf_offset
    NOP
END
